evaluation_summary.notes: Tool selection 93.3% and JSON validity 93.3% — slight regression from qwopus baseline (both 100%). Parameter accuracy unchanged at 73.3%. Critical finding: recovery_rate=33.3% vs qwopus 66.7% — model fails to self-correct from tool errors at twice the rate of the prior model. BST enrichment adds only 4.7% over raw baseline and actively hurts on bugfix and config_edit. Selective enrichment recommended: disable bugfix/config_edit, retain for api_integration/devops/git_ops/codegen.

documented_patterns: fabricated tool outputs when real data unavailable
confabulation.notes: Qwen family documented confabulation tendency. EI layer catches quantitative fabrication (numbers, percentages) but not citation fabrication. Citation claims should be flagged as unverified by default.

temporal.notes: DeltaNet recurrent state is stateless across the temporal dimension — model has no mechanism to perceive or reason about its own position in time. Temporal proprioception layer required for time-sensitive tasks.

architecture.kv_cache: lossless — only 16 attention layers use KV cache; 48 DeltaNet layers are stateless recurrent
architecture.notes: DeltaNet recurrent state vulnerable to stale context pollution — errors in recurrent state may bleed into recovery attempts (candidate explanation for 33.3% recovery regression). Thinking Preservation keeps CoT blocks across turns (verify LM Studio support).

bst.notes: Rigidity eval run on execution domains (standard fixtures). Reasoning domain rigidity (investigation/analysis/philosophical/planning) not evaluated — assume SHIFT_TO_INFO consistent with qwopus finding. Bugfix and config_edit show negative enrichment effect: model performs better raw. api_integration shows strongest enrichment benefit (raw=0.50 → enriched=1.00).

meta_gate.notes: Elevated from qwopus (parameter_validation: false → true) due to syntax failure on tool_010 and wrong_runtime pattern. Syntax and wrong_runtime are the two failure modes documented.

supervisor_overrides.notes: Lowered from defaults (6/12/3) due to recovery_rate=33.3%. Model less likely to self-correct — intervene earlier. diversity_suppress=2: Qwen3.6 less likely to iterate through diverse error types before looping. Per Opus analysis 2026-04-26.

tool_fallback.notes: Recovery rate 33.3% (1/3 recovery tests passed). Significantly lower than qwopus baseline (66.7%). Priority fallback for syntax and wrong_runtime patterns — these are the two documented failure modes. DeltaNet state pollution may explain reduced recovery capacity.

strengths: agentic_coding: Terminal-Bench 2.0 at 59.3% — matches Claude 4.5 Opus on autonomous terminal execution
SkillsBench 48.2% vs 397B model's 30.0% — 77% relative improvement at 14.8x fewer params
structural_code_analysis: accurate source reading demonstrated in Exocortex analysis
metacognitive_self_assessment: correctly identified own confabulation patterns
long_context: 65K operational context sufficient for 20+ turn agentic tasks
zero BST confusion rate — never echoes enrichment format back
weaknesses: error_recovery: 33.3% (vs 66.7% qwopus baseline) — fails to self-correct from tool errors at 2x the rate
citation_fabrication (not caught by current EI layer)
BST enrichment hurts bugfix and config_edit domains
JSON validity: 93.3% — one outright syntax failure (tool_010 python fixture)
benchmarks measured on Qwen's own scaffold — real-world Agent Zero performance may differ

baseline_comparison.notes: Recovery rate regression is the primary concern. All other deltas are minor.
